title: Preservation Across a Memory Read
statement: Let $K_0,B,P$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{orc}:\{0,1,2,3\}\to\{0,1\}^*\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be an oracle, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Let $st$ be a machine state whose 17 register values are all at most $B$, let $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a memory, let $p\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy $0\le p\le P$, and let $l,l_1,l_0$ be control states. If the instruction at $l$ reads the memory bit at position $p$, continuing at $l_1$ when $M(p)$ is true and at $l_0$ when it is false, then every guarded finite run from the selected successor configuration—with state $st$, memory $M$, and head position $p$—to a configuration $c$ can be prefixed by this read: there is a guarded finite run from the configuration at $l$ with the same state, memory, and head position to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: an oracle on four indices and Boolean words
a state $st$ with all 17 register values at most $B$
the instruction at $l$ reads the memory bit and branches to $l_1$ or $l_0$ according to its value
guarded reachability from the selected successor configuration to $c$
replaced:
Let $K_0,B,P$ be natural numbers, let
$\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{Bool}$ be an
oracle, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Suppose a machine instruction at control state
$l$ reads the memory bit at the head and branches to $l_1$ when it is true and to $l_0$
when it is false. Let $st$ be a register state whose 17 counters are all at most $B$,
let the memory head position $p$ satisfy $0\le p\le P$, and let $c$ be reachable from
the configuration at state $l_1$ or $l_0$ selected by the memory bit at $p$, with the
guard maintained at every earlier step. Then $c$ is also reachable from the
configuration at state $l$ with the same register values, memory, and head position,
with that guard maintained at every earlier step.
